conbody.p: The ISG system will operate under the following conditions:

li.p: The driver’s seat belt is fastened.
The driver’s door and hood are closed.
Brake vacuum pressure is adequate.
The battery sensor is activated and the battery is sufficiently charged.
The outside temperature is within the operating range (not too low or too high).
The climate control system conditions are satisfied.
The vehicle is sufficiently warmed up.
The vehicle is not on a steep road grade (Excluding Manual Transmission).
The steering wheel is not turned to a sharp angle.
The vehicle is not at a high elevation.
The front windshield defroster is off.
Manual shift mode is not selected (Excluding Manual Transmission).
A certain amount of time has passed after releasing the gear position from R (Reverse).

conbody.p: The engine will also restart automatically, without any driver action, if one of the following occurs:

li.p: Brake vacuum pressure is low.
The maximum engine-off time has been exceeded.
The air conditioning is on with the fan speed set to the highest position.
Window fogging may occur while the air conditioning is on.
The battery is not within the optimal operating range.
Climate control system heating or cooling performance is unsatisfactory.
The ISG OFF button is pressed while the engine is automatically stopped (Excluding Manual Transmission).
The vehicle begins moving after standstill.
The accelerator and brake pedals are pressed at the same time (Excluding Manual Transmission).
The driver’s seat belt is unfastened or the driver’s door is ajar (Excluding Manual Transmission).

conbody.p: The green AUTO STOP indicator () on the instrument cluster will blink for 5 seconds.

note.p: If the ISG system does not meet the operating conditions, the ISG system will be deactivated.
